# NETRA LLM Gateway

> Sovereign AI gateway and tenant-isolated semantic vector cache with drop-in OpenAI API compatibility, dynamic cost arbitrage routing, and instant phantom spend reclamation.

## Technical Baseline
- Core Runtime: Java 25 LTS, Spring Boot 4.1.1, Gradle 9 Kotlin DSL on Java Virtual Threads.
- Storage: PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector extension (384-dimension vector index), Redis 8.0 Lua JIT.
- Semantic Engine: Two-Tier Cache hierarchy (Tier-1 exact SHA-256 hash <0.5ms + Tier-2 In-JVM ONNX all-MiniLM-L6-v2 with pgvector HNSW <5ms).

## Key APIs
- `POST /v1/chat/completions`: OpenAI-compatible endpoint supporting unbuffered streaming SSE, non-streaming responses, multi-provider failover, and intelligent routing.
- `GET /health`: Health and readiness probe returning service status and version.
- `GET /health/live`: Liveness probe for container orchestration.
- `GET /health/ready`: Synthetic readiness probe verifying PostgreSQL and Redis.
- `GET /admin/providers/health`: Live provider resilience telemetry, circuit breaker states, and p95 latency.
- `GET /admin/usage`: Aggregated token counts, spend in USD, and cache hits.
- `GET /admin/logs`: Chronological audit logs for requests and rejections.
- `POST /admin/logs/stream-ticket`: Ephemeral 60s stream tickets for secure browser EventSource authentication.
- `GET /admin/logs/stream`: Real-time Server-Sent Events stream of incoming audit logs.
- `GET /admin/keys`: Virtual key management and tenant quota status.
- `GET /admin/currency/rate`: Dynamic live USD to INR exchange rate.
- `GET /admin/pricing`: Dynamic model aliases, active pricing rates, and provider catalog.
- `GET /admin/cache/stats`: Aggregate cache hit rate, total vector entries, and per-tenant breakdown.
- `DELETE /admin/cache/entries/{id}`: Evicts a cached vector/exact completion entry by ID.

## Operations Console (`console/`)
- Modern React 19 / Vite 6 console with OpenRouter-grade analytics suite.
- 5 Headline KPI cards, 4 interactive SVG charts, single-denomination USD/INR toggle, dark/light theme engine.
- Developer Sandbox with 1-click demo profiles for Search, Research, Free Tier, and Budget demo.
